decisions.reason: Margin analysis draws directly on the firm's maintained tariff and market-data databases, so in-house R&D lets it read early results and refine the product cheaply.

Gas tariff comparison sits close to the core data and calculation competencies and fits the platform strategy, though the earlier withdrawal of the site-specific comparison line shows some consolidation pressure among comparison tools.
The regional electricity tariff calculator closely extends established know-how, has its own web page, and is easy for the firm to interpret and improve.

This multi-model calculator line builds on existing knowledge, but it is only mentioned on the website and overlaps with C, so it is the most likely candidate for consolidation, as happened with F, though keeping it for now is reasonable.
The area definition tool uses the firm's regional and network data expertise and supports its other location-based products within the central platform.
